race.comment: Deep edition of the Seymour Cup. STORM LEOPARD (11) pulled up with excuses after being well backed at Flemington second up and fading. Back slightly in trip to a mile off a freshen is okay, he can hold a spot from the inside gate and take beating with 54kg. AL DUCA (4) ran well in the Golden Nugget in second last time out. Drawn out, but he has enough early speed to roll across and Zahra's booking is a positive sign. Rates highly on his latest effort and can go one better without surprising. DETONATOR JACK (3) is going well and will be running on strongly. LIM'S SALTORO (7) was solid in the Testa Rossa and looks suited up to a mile now.
